latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with streamlined Node.js-based bounty search.

- Transitioned from a Python-based autonomous agent to a lightweight Node.js utility
- Finds and reports low-competition GitHub bounty issues, filtering by comment count
- Generates clean, sorted reports with bounty details and estimated difficulty
- Removed prior automation features (proposal submission, payment management, etc.)
- Simplified installation and usage via `npx` commands
